title: 兩奈米以下製程架構
summary: 以奈米片電晶體、接觸與背面供電建立先進節點概念。節點名稱不是每一個結構的實際幾何尺寸。
summaryEn: Study nanosheet devices, contacts and backside power delivery. A process-node name is not the physical size of every feature.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

steps.title: 解讀節點名稱
steps.objective: 完成「解讀節點名稱」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for interpret node names.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 節點標籤代表技術世代，應以公開 PPA 與結構資料比較。
knowledge.textEn: Node labels identify technology generations; comparisons need public PPA and structural data.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 把節點標籤與閘長、接觸間距、金屬間距分成不同欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Separate node label, gate length, contact pitch and metal pitch in a table.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「兩奈米以下製程架構」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「解讀節點名稱」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：節點名稱不是所有實體尺寸，也不是單一性能排名。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：兩奈米以下製程架構 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「節點名稱不是所有實體尺寸，也不是單一性能排名」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Sub-2 nm Process Architectures as the task boundary. After reading “Interpret node names”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Node labels are neither all physical dimensions nor a single performance ranking. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Device integration: gate stack to backside power”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Sub-2 nm Process Architectures: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Node labels are neither all physical dimensions nor a single performance ranking” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

steps.check: 把節點標籤與閘長、接觸間距、金屬間距分成不同欄位。
steps.checkEn: Separate node label, gate length, contact pitch and metal pitch in a table.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「解讀節點名稱」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains interpret node names?
options: 節點標籤代表技術世代，應以公開 PPA 與結構資料比較。
動態功耗與切換電容、電壓平方和頻率相關，漏電另有不同來源。
增加閘極對通道的包覆可改善靜電控制，但也提高製程整合複雜度。
optionsEn: Node labels identify technology generations; comparisons need public PPA and structural data.
Dynamic power depends on switched capacitance, voltage squared and frequency; leakage has separate origins.
Greater gate enclosure improves electrostatic control but increases integration complexity.
quiz.explanation: 節點標籤代表技術世代，應以公開 PPA 與結構資料比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Node labels identify technology generations; comparisons need public PPA and structural data.
